report:
(A) Left SLN 1
(B) Breast, left, total mastectomy

(A) Received fresh, a piece of fibroadipose tissue measuring 3 x 2 x 1 cm. Two lymph nodes are identified within, measuring approximately 1.2 cm and 0.8 cm across respectively. The fatty tissue is stripped off. All embedded in 2 frozen blocks, and subsequently processed to paraffin.

(B) The specimen consists of a left total mastectomy specimen (520 g, 190 x 160 x 45 mm) with an overlying skin ellipse (170 x 60 mm) bearing the nipple. Sectioning reveals a firm, grey-white, ill-defined, stellate tumour measuring 23 mm in greatest dimension (23 x 20 x 18 mm) in the upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock, 30 mm from the nipple), 5 mm from the posterior margin. The skin and nipple are unremarkable. The remaining breast tissue is fibrofatty and unremarkable.

(B1-4) tumour with the closest posterior margin.
(B5) nipple.
(B6-9) anterior, superior, inferior and lateral margins.
(B10) medial margin.
(B11-12) background breast.

(Dr. HY Tan)
(A) Metastatic carcinoma, >2 mm (1 of 2 lymph nodes).
The frozen section diagnosis was phone reported at 1015 on 12/09/2026.

(A) The paraffin sections confirm the frozen section diagnosis. They show fibroadipose tissue and two lymph nodes, one of which is involved by metastatic carcinoma (macrometastasis, 4 mm).

(B) Breast, left, total mastectomy
Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total mastectomy
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock, 30 mm from the nipple)
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 23 mm (23 x 20 x 18 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (ductal)
- Tumour focality: Single focus of invasive carcinoma
- Histologic grade: Grade 2 (scores of 6 or 7); total score 6
- Tubule formation: Score 3
- Nuclear pleomorphism: Score 2
- Mitotic rate: Score 1
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show an invasive carcinoma of no special type, Nottingham grade
  2 (tubule formation 3, nuclear pleomorphism 2, mitotic count 1; total 6),
  measuring 23 mm in greatest dimension. The tumour infiltrates as nests, cords
  and irregular glands of cells with moderately pleomorphic nuclei and variably
  conspicuous nucleoli, within a desmoplastic stroma. Ductal carcinoma in situ
  of intermediate nuclear grade, cribriform and solid types, without necrosis,
  is present (15 mm). There is no lymphovascular invasion. The nipple and skin
  are not involved.
- Tumour extension: Confined to the breast parenchyma
  - Nipple: Present and not involved
  - Skin: Present and not involved
  - Skin satellite foci: Not identified
  - Skeletal muscle: Not present in specimen
- Lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Dermal lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Breast treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Ductal carcinoma in situ: Present, Negative for extensive intraductal
  component (EIC)
  - Size (extent) of DCIS: 15 mm
  - Number of blocks with DCIS: 3 of 12 blocks examined
  - Nuclear grade: Grade II (intermediate)
  - Necrosis: Not identified
  - Architectural patterns: Cribriform, Solid
- Additional lesions: Not identified
- Microcalcifications: Present in DCIS

Ancillary studies
- Biomarker studies: Reported on the prior core biopsy (S26-01234): ER positive
  (90%, strong), PR positive (60%, moderate), HER2 negative (score 1+), Ki-67
  15%
